nodes.label: GitHub Clone & Cross-Repo Merge Reference Doc
nodes.norm_label: github clone & cross-repo merge reference doc

nodes.label: 16KB page-size linker fix (max-page-size=16384)
nodes.rationale: Without -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384, dlopen fails with UnsatisfiedLinkError on Android 15+ devices using 16KB memory page size.

nodes.label: Database transactions must be properly handled
nodes.rationale: Ensure DB operations are wrapped in transactions with rollback handling in all code paths including error scenarios.
nodes.norm_label: database transactions must be properly handled

nodes.label: API responses must include proper error context
nodes.rationale: Error responses should include debugging context (request id, timestamp, user context) without exposing sensitive information.
nodes.norm_label: api responses must include proper error context

nodes.label: Async operations should have timeout handling
nodes.rationale: Long-running async operations (API calls, DB queries, file operations) should have timeout mechanisms to prevent hanging requests.
nodes.norm_label: async operations should have timeout handling

nodes.label: گزارش بررسی صفحه لیست کشتی‌ها (Ships List Review Report)
nodes.norm_label: گزارش بررسی صفحه لیست کشتی‌ها (ships list review report)

nodes.label: P0: Missing authentication on app_api.php
nodes.rationale: AppApiController::requireAuthenticatedSession() added, validating X-Username/X-Device-Id/X-Session-Token via SessionService::isValidToken() to close a complete authentication gap.

nodes.label: P0: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on unauth proxy
nodes.rationale: Open CORS header removed from protected_proxy.php since only the Android app consumes it and CORS is unnecessary.

nodes.label: P0: LazyColumn crash from duplicate ship name key
nodes.rationale: Composite key "${ship.name}|${ship.cargoType}" replaced the plain ship.name key to avoid duplicate LazyColumn key crashes.
nodes.norm_label: p0: lazycolumn crash from duplicate ship name key

nodes.label: P0: Proxy whitelist equals all *.php files
nodes.rationale: Only check_table_structure.php (a diagnostic tool leaking user_sessions table structure) was removed from the whitelist; full manual allow-list deferred due to risk of breaking ~30 unverified consumers.
nodes.norm_label: p0: proxy whitelist equals all *.php files

nodes.label: Bug: session_token/sessionToken field name mismatch
nodes.rationale: Server returned session_token (snake_case) but Android Gson model expected sessionToken (camelCase), causing an empty token to be stored for years, masked until real auth validation was added; fixed with @SerializedName("session_token").

nodes.label: Bug: phantom column loadingQuotaNumberReversed
nodes.rationale: checkQuotaExistenceCargo() referenced a column that never existed in InitialInfo; replaced with a computed REVERSE(loadingQuotaNumber) instead of adding a real column.

nodes.label: CargoInfo netWeight/loadingQuotaNumber type migration to INT
nodes.rationale: Columns were varchar(100) causing implicit CAST(... AS DOUBLE) in JOINs; migrated to INT after a three-pass read-only safety audit, with CargoRepository::insertCargo() converting empty string to NULL to satisfy STRICT_TRANS_TABLES.
nodes.norm_label: cargoinfo netweight/loadingquotanumber type migration to int

nodes.label: CargoInfo composite covering indexes
nodes.rationale: EXPLAIN ANALYZE showed 97% of query time was a full unindexed scan of 58k rows; idx_cargo_status_group and idx_cargo_ship_lookup indexes cut query time from ~245ms to ~100ms.

nodes.label: گزارش بررسی جزئیات کشتی — کوتاژها و انبارها (Quotas & Warehouses Review Report)
nodes.norm_label: گزارش بررسی جزيیات کشتی — کوتاژها و انبارها (quotas & warehouses review report)

nodes.label: P0: DELETE from CargoInfo missing cargoType condition
nodes.rationale: Deleting one quota's cargo type row also deletes all other cargo-type vouchers sharing the same composite key, because the CargoInfo DELETE query omits AND cargoType = ? unlike the InitialInfo DELETE.
nodes.norm_label: p0: delete from cargoinfo missing cargotype condition

nodes.label: P0: No permission control on write/delete operations
nodes.rationale: Only session validity (requireAuthenticatedSession) gates write actions; PermissionManager.php exists in the project but is never called, so any authenticated user can delete quota history.
nodes.norm_label: p0: no permission control on write/delete operations

nodes.label: P0: toggleQuotaStatus/updateQuotaPercentage not scoped to unique row
nodes.rationale: loadingQuotaNumber is not unique in InitialInfo; updateQuotaPercentage/updateQuotaPercentageRestriction always update by loadingQuotaNumber alone, affecting rows belonging to other ships/companies.
nodes.norm_label: p0: togglequotastatus/updatequotapercentage not scoped to unique row

nodes.label: P0: NullPointerException in calculateWarningStatus
nodes.rationale: quota.isPercentageRestricted!! crashes on a nullable Boolean? field defaulted to false in the model, breaking composition-phase rendering of ShipDetailsScreen.

nodes.label: P0: All write/delete operations use HTTP GET
nodes.rationale: deleteQuota and other mutating actions are @GET requests, enabling replay attacks, unwanted HTTP caching, and query-string parameter leakage into access logs.
nodes.norm_label: p0: all write/delete operations use http get

nodes.label: گزارش بررسی عملکرد و بهینه‌سازی — ATK-Cargo (Performance Optimization Report)
nodes.norm_label: گزارش بررسی عملکرد و بهینه‌سازی — atk-cargo (performance optimization report)

nodes.label: protected_proxy.php rewrite with APCu whitelist/rate-limit caching
nodes.rationale: Whitelist caching (APCu, 5min TTL), rate-limit tracking moved from disk JSON to APCu, and log writes deferred via fastcgi_finish_request to cut per-request fixed cost.
nodes.norm_label: protected_proxy.php rewrite with apcu whitelist/rate-limit caching

nodes.label: MicroCache server-side caching class
nodes.rationale: New App\Core\MicroCache helper (APCu, short TTL, fails gracefully without APCu) applied to getShipsList, getActiveShips, getRealTimeData, getUnreadCount, syncPermissions to reduce repeated heavy queries.

nodes.label: Baseline Profile generation + 16KB page-size crash discovery
nodes.rationale: While building the baselineprofile module, a critical crash was found on 16KB memory page-size devices (Android 15+); fixed via target_link_options in CMakeLists.txt; androidx.benchmark upgraded 1.3.3->1.4.1 to support Android 16 for profile generation.
nodes.norm_label: baseline profile generation + 16kb page-size crash discovery

nodes.label: kapt to KSP migration for Room
nodes.rationale: kotlin-kapt replaced with com.google.devtools.ksp to speed up Room annotation processing build times.
nodes.norm_label: kapt to ksp migration for room

nodes.label: Bug: getGroupedQuotas ignored shipName filter (over-fetch)
nodes.rationale: Server ignored the shipName parameter Android already sent, always returning all 308 rows for all ships; applying the filter cut response size by 96% for filtered requests.

nodes.label: گزارش بررسی مسیر راه‌اندازی — Splash→Login→NavHost (Startup Path Review Report)
nodes.norm_label: گزارش بررسی مسیر راه‌اندازی — splash→login→navhost (startup path review report)

nodes.label: C-1: fixed 4.5s splash delay
nodes.rationale: Splash always waited exactly 4500ms regardless of network readiness; replaced with adaptive splash (min 1200ms, max 4500ms) closing early once network job completes.

nodes.label: C-2: complete offline lockout with no recovery
nodes.rationale: Any network failure in verifySecurityStatus() blocked the app with no retry and no offline grace period; a 3-day OFFLINE_GRACE_PERIOD_MS grace period and retry button were added.
nodes.norm_label: c-2: complete offline lockout with no recovery

nodes.label: C-4: CryptoManager silently stores plaintext on error
nodes.rationale: encrypt()/decrypt() returned the raw/ciphertext string on exception, silently persisting plaintext credentials when the AndroidKeyStore key became invalid; changed to return empty string with logging.
nodes.norm_label: c-4: cryptomanager silently stores plaintext on error

nodes.label: P1-4: hardware benchmark with System.gc() on startup
nodes.rationale: CPU/GPU/memory benchmarking including a forced System.gc() ran on Main thread at startup only to pick an animation variant; removed in favor of a cheap heuristic (availableProcessors + refreshRate + isLowRamDevice).
nodes.norm_label: p1-4: hardware benchmark with system.gc() on startup

nodes.label: B-1: deviceId mismatch between login and logout
nodes.rationale: Login used Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID while logout used Build.DISPLAY, so server-side logout silently failed to find the session record even though the client cleared local credentials.
nodes.norm_label: b-1: deviceid mismatch between login and logout

nodes.label: P1-3: 15s x2 SecurityVerifier timeouts on critical path
nodes.rationale: Worst case wait exceeded 60s on ServerSyncingScreen with no cancel/retry; BUFFER_DURATION reduced to 8000ms and license_info/license_check calls parallelized.
nodes.norm_label: p1-3: 15s x2 securityverifier timeouts on critical path
